article.title: 更進新聞：Scrunch列出AI引用來源，協助擬定媒體聯絡內容
article.summary: Sitecore旗下Scrunch推出Citation Optimization，可查閱AI答案引用的第三方頁面及其優先次序。
highlights: 可檢視哪些來源提及品牌或競爭對手。
Scrunch稱功能已可使用，資料亦會供MarketingIQ參考。
article.why: 公關團隊可把AI搜尋監測連到具體刊物和評測頁，優先核實資料缺口。
article.next_step: 抽查十條重要查詢，核對主要引用頁，再把聯絡草稿交公關審閱。
article.detail: Scrunch表示新功能會按追蹤的提示詞列出第三方引用頁，並按影響及接觸機會排序。團隊可查閱頁面已收錄的品牌及競爭對手，再以已批准的品牌資料擬定聯絡內容。資料可供MarketingIQ參考，公關團隊仍應逐一核對頁面內容，並記錄對方是否更新。
article.title_en: Update: Scrunch maps AI citations and helps draft publisher outreach
article.summary_en: Sitecore's Scrunch launched Citation Optimization to identify and prioritize third-party pages cited in AI answers.
highlights_en: Teams can see which sources mention their brand or competitors.
Scrunch says the feature is available and its data informs MarketingIQ.
article.why_en: PR teams can link AI-search monitoring to specific publications and review pages and validate gaps.
article.next_step_en: Sample ten important queries, verify the main citations and have PR review outreach drafts.
article.detail_en: Scrunch says the feature finds third-party citations for tracked prompts and prioritizes pages by influence and outreach opportunity. Teams can see which brands and competitors are included and draft pitches with approved brand information. The data can inform MarketingIQ. PR teams should check cited pages individually and track whether publishers make updates.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
article.followup: 11月12日版報道MarketingIQ。本次新增的是Scrunch的第三方來源排序與聯絡功能。
article.followup_en: November 12 covered MarketingIQ. The new story is Scrunch's third-party citation prioritization and outreach.
